summary: Akaunting is a self-hosted PHP/Laravel double-entry accounting suite: invoices, bills, payments (transactions/transfers/reconciliations) across companies sharing one install, with contacts/customers/vendors, items, categories/currencies/taxes, users/roles/permissions, dashboards/widgets/reports, a client portal, and a module/app marketplace, all persisted in a MySQL-backed relational store

_no_edges.why: internal job, no route, no authorize, calls nothing
internal job calling only RolePermission sync; no guard wall of its own
internal job; FK cascade handles RolePermission; no authorize
read under admin group (read-admin-panel); no per-resource guard beyond that
Called by CreateTransaction/UpdateTransaction. Inserts TransactionTax rows directly via TransactionTax::create; calls no other op and has no guard wall of its own.
Inserts Account row directly (Account::create); no calls to other ops. Side effect setting default.account via setting()->set. No wall.
Direct row update + setting side effect; does not dispatch other ops. Has guard wall authorize() (default account disable check, currency change check).
